chapter_title_en: The Emergence of the Stone-Man Kings
chapter_seo_title: Three Otherworld Stone Man Kings Descend on the Nine Provinces
chapter_meta_description: Lang Ya is destroyed, but three more stone man kings emerge. The Ninety-Nine Stone Steps loom over the battlefield as a dark ritual begins. Hope fades for the Nine Provinces.
og_title: Three Stone Man Kings Appear – The Ninety-Nine Stone Steps Descend
og_description: The old stone man king falls, but three more appear in full power. The Nine Provinces face extinction as the Eternal Unknown descends.
twitter_title: Three Stone Man Kings Descend on the Nine Provinces
twitter_description: Victory is snatched away as three intact stone man kings emerge and begin a dark resurrection ritual.
